name: task-manager-uat
description: Operator-only Task Manager UAT profile with separate hosted MCP and on-demand local-file upload.

interface.shortDescription: Validate Task Manager safely against UAT.
interface.longDescription: Operator-only validation profile. Hosted UAT MCP and the macOS exact-path uploader are separate connections. The local process exposes only upload_local_file, performs no discovery-time network or credential access, and keeps Task Manager OAuth only in process memory. Use synthetic data only.
defaultPrompt: List my UAT tasks and confirm the connector origin
Upload an exact local file into Task Manager UAT
Run the UAT file-first upload and bind smoke
